personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: Smaller context means faster, cheaper agent runs across every repository, and invade sets it up without me.

personas.name: Lead Engineer

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: A red check about a file I never opened would stop my quick win, and I would not know what to do.

objection.text: I push quick wins for customers and I don't master the harness. If my PR goes red because a markdown file I never opened is 2 KB too big, I won't know what to cut or whom to ask, and the quick win waits.
